_comment: Gate 0 baseline. First live run 2026-06-30 against a local 1-container stack (pgvector pg16 :5433 + local ollama nomic-embed-text). Chat smoke via ollama.com qwen3.5:cloud. NOTE: the ollama.com cloud key is CHAT-ONLY (/api/embed -> unauthorized); embeddings require a local/embedding-capable backend. tool_selection metrics are over the 3 seed fixtures only and reflect the facade-vs-discovered naming mismatch (see observations); re-run after fixture retargeting + with real fixtures.

boot.readiness: OUT_OF_SERVICE (environmental — no eureka/security-service/gateway in the 1-container stack)

observations.tool_selection_hit_at_5_zero: The 3 seed fixtures targeted discovered-convention tool names (e.g. workorders_getallworkorders), but the live tool set is 16 coarse facade tools whose mcp_tool.name = the class name (WorkorderFacadeTool, ...). So expected tools were never in top-5. Two seed fixtures retargeted to facade names (WorkorderFacadeTool; forbidden AccountingFacadeTool). Real fixtures (Gate 0 exit) must target the live tool set.
